from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Literal
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UserCreatedData:
    color: Literal["red", "green", "blue"]
    mixed_const: Literal["s", 3, null, [1,"a",null]]
    maybe_color: Literal["red", "green"] | None = None
    nested: Literal["x", "y", "z"] | None = None
    one_of_const: Literal[1, 2] | None = None
    obj_const: str = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> UserCreatedData:
        return cls(
            color=data.get("color"),
            mixed_const=data.get("mixedConst"),
            maybe_color=data.get("maybeColor"),
            nested=data.get("nested"),
            one_of_const=data.get("oneOfConst"),
            obj_const=data.get("objConst"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "color": self.color,
            "mixedConst": self.mixed_const,
            "maybeColor": self.maybe_color,
            "nested": self.nested,
            "oneOfConst": self.one_of_const,
            "objConst": self.obj_const,
        }
